title: Impact Lab assembly scene, version 1
description: Hand-written, generated or saved Impact Lab scenes. SI units throughout: metres, seconds, m/s, pascals, kg/m³; angles in degrees. Omitted settings take the workshop defaults. Impact Lab itself applies further cross-field rules (listed in docs/SCENE_FORMAT.md) and explains any violation.

description.description: Free text. Not kept when the app saves.

gravity.description: Downward (−Y) acceleration on every free body, m/s². true means 9.80665. Omit for no gravity.

meshResolution.description: Assembly mesh for every body without its own refinement. Default standard.

monitor.description: Body tracked in the motion plot. Default: the first body.

relativeTo.description: Plot the monitored body's motion relative to this body.

bodyOrder.description: Workshop list order only; does not affect physics.

id.description: A UUID, or for bodies any readable text such as "striker". Optional; generated when omitted.

bodyReference.description: A body's name, readable id or UUID.

resolution.description: Element size about 9 mm divided by the level: standard 9, fine 4.5, extraFine 3, x4 2.25, x5 1.8, x6 1.5, x7 1.29 mm.

elasticOnly.description: Use the profile's elastic constants without its J2 plasticity.

provenance.description: Written by the app for library profiles. Prefer the profile form when writing by hand.

plasticity.description: Only for custom materials. A profile sets plasticity itself.

yieldFraction.description: Yield stress as a fraction of Young's modulus, when no table is given.

hardeningFraction.description: Linear hardening modulus as a fraction of Young's modulus, when no table is given.

points.description: Equivalent plastic strain (0–1, starting at 0, increasing) and Kirchhoff flow stress (Pa, never decreasing).

outline.description: General shape in the body frame, metres; its box is centred on center. Size defaults to the box.

meshSize.description: Target triangle edge length, m. Default 0.012 / n on the ×n mesh.

center.description: Body centre, m, each coordinate −10 to 10.

size.description: Width and height (or the two diameters of a round body), each 0.0005–10 m; advisory notes below 25 mm ÷ n and above 0.30 m. Required unless an outline is given.

velocity.description: Initial uniform velocity [vx, vy], m/s, each −150 to 150.

wall.description: Enclosure wall thickness, m; 0.005 m to 0.4 × the smaller size.

refinement.description: This body's mesh level, overriding meshResolution.

support.description: fixed: rigid, immovable bench or fixture (width up to 1.0 m). clamp…: that local edge is held. Supported bodies start at rest and cannot fracture.

fracture.description: Illustrative cohesive cracking. Blocks and enclosures with a custom (non-profile) material only.

strengthFraction.description: Tensile strength as a fraction of Young's modulus.

strength.description: Cohesive strength in pascals. Replaces strengthFraction (give one, not both); energy is then required and may be up to 1000000 J/m².

energySource.description: Citation for an estimated energy: status, citation, url, caution.

notch.description: V-notch on the local bottom edge of a block.

bondedLayer.description: Bonded second (and third) material along the block's local x axis. Each layer may yield (plasticity), crack (fracture) and delaminate from the layer before it (bond). Layer fracture and bond need the body's fracture on. Blocks without a notch only.

plasticity.description: J2 plasticity for this layer only, same keys as a body's plasticity.

fracture.description: This layer's crack strength and energy, same keys as a body's fracture without meshPattern. Omit and the layer never cracks.

bond.description: Cohesive bond with the previous layer (strengthFraction against the softer side's E, or strength in Pa, and energy in J/m²). Omit and the bond never fails.
Cohesive bond with the second layer.

firstAnchor.description: On the first body, in fractions of its half-size (−1 to 1). [1, 0] is the middle of its right edge.

stiffness.description: N/m² (force per unit extension, per metre of out-of-plane depth). Shown as kN/m² in the app.

criticalExtension.description: Extension at which a breakable link fails, m.

span.description: Spread the link along the edge, as a fraction of the half-size.

preload.description: Springs only. Starting stretch in m (positive stretched, negative compressed). Rest length = starting distance − preload, at least 0.5 mm.

location.description: In the body's own (unrotated) coordinates: metres from its centre, or fractions of its half-size when usesBodyFractions is true. Must lie inside material.
